blocks.html: Copies of the approved mix design(s) shall be maintained at the construction site by the contractor and made available to the department upon request. A copy of the approved mix design(s) shall be provided by the contractor to the licensed concrete testing laboratory performing the acceptance testing of the concrete at the construction site.
